_doc: Where each red claim lives in the implementation. The Lean ledger says what is red and proves it absent; this says where the code that fails it is, so the book can print the line beside the claim and a fixer can jump to it. Keyed by the witness theorem, which is stable. A null line means the whole file is the site. Maintained by hand: nothing can infer a line number from a theorem, and a guess would be worse than a blank.

Streaming.a_per_chunk_decoder_copies_the.note: decompress_into takes a caller buffer, but the per-chunk path above copies through a Vec

Consistency.a_total_count_can_hide_a_mis.note: the error branch a per-datacenter shortfall falls through when only the total is checked

Commons.Stream.a_gap_is_either_resumable.note: Lagged carries a count and no position, so the client cannot resume

Flight.a_stream_ticket_is_not_a_range_se.note: the only ticket type is a token-range SELECT; no stream ticket exists

Commons.Hll.merge_is_commutative.note: a Bloom filter plus a counter of values new to it: bits do not determine a count, so two shards cannot merge

Jepsen.a_read_only_transaction_can_carry.note: the harness asserts strict serializability over the whole history; it does not isolate read-only transactions

_status: STOPGAP, hand-maintained. The intended source is Charon's span table from the Aeneas extraction, which records file and line for every function it translates; until that is wired, this file is six hand-checked anchors out of fifty-nine red claims and is not a substitute for it.
